sentences.text: This section establishes the operating context and naming convention for the offshore wind farm operations and maintenance system.
The system boundary covers offshore generation assets, supporting marine and shore facilities, operational personnel, and external organizations involved in farm activities.
The farm operates in a variable marine environment where access, equipment condition, and grid requirements influence the timing and conduct of work.
Canonical entity names are used throughout this document to identify system parts, actors, operational states, and controlled items.
In this document, Turbine Controller is referred to by the alias Glassfin.
In this document, Offshore Substation is referred to by the alias Morrowick.
In this document, Weather Service is referred to by the alias Pale Lantern.
The Turbine Controller represents the control function associated with an individual turbine.
Pitch System and Rotor Brake Unit are turbine subsystems considered within the operational boundary.
Converter Cabinet and Nacelle Condition Monitor are treated as distinct turbine equipment for maintenance planning and condition review.
The Blade Inspection Drone is an operational asset used for turbine blade assessment.
The Offshore Substation provides the farm's offshore electrical collection and switching environment.
Main Transformer and Export Cable Monitor are included as substation and export-system assets, respectively.
SCADA Gateway is the supervisory interface associated with farm monitoring and control operations.
Shore Control Room provides a shore-based operating location for authorized personnel.
Fleet Dispatch Console supports the coordination of operational resources across the farm.
Maintenance Planning Engine supports the preparation and sequencing of maintenance activities.
Weather Service represents the external weather information capability considered by farm operations.
Metocean Buoy represents an offshore source of environmental observations within the operating context.
Crew Transfer Vessel, Daughter Craft, and Service Operations Vessel represent marine resources that may support offshore work.
Helideck is included as an access facility for activities supported by helicopter operations.
Personnel Tracking Console represents the personnel location and accountability function.
Warehouse System and Spares Hub represent the inventory and logistics context for maintenance materials.
Work Permit Portal and Cybersecurity Gateway represent enabling functions that support controlled and secure operations.
The operating concept also recognizes grid, emergency response, communications, and port support as external or enabling capabilities.
